name: NoSlop Full-Stack Router
description: Unified master skill router loading only the 1-2 needed reference playbooks per task across UI craft, motion, responsiveness, redesign, backend APIs, and security.

name: 01 · Design & Anti-Slop Floor
description: Mode selection (Operate/Read/Persuade/Experience), type ratios, 4-level text hierarchy, whisper-quiet elevation, concentric radii, and concrete AI-slop ban list.

name: 02 · Motion & 60fps Interaction
description: Frequency-based animation gating, tuned cubic-bezier curves, <=200ms feedback, tactile :active scale(0.97), compositor-only transform/opacity, FLIP, and reduced motion.

name: 03 · Responsive & WCAG A11y
description: Container queries for reusable components, 100dvh/minmax(0,1fr) guards, 320px-1440px + 812x375 + 200% zoom QA matrix, and WCAG 2.2 AA focus/ARIA rules.

name: 04 · Redesign & Audit Playbook
description: Polish vs full redesign vs divergent prototype, DESIGN.md extraction, severity ranking, cheaper-fix ladder (Delete -> Platform -> Token -> Fix -> Add), and Before/After reporting.

name: 05 · Backend, APIs & Database
description: Contract-first APIs, uniform error envelopes, strict boundary validation, authn/authz checks, SQL constraints/indexes/transactions, N+1 prevention, idempotency, and timeouts.

name: 06 · Security, Testing & Ops
description: HTTPS/HSTS/CSP/cookie hardening, secrets hygiene, rate limits, real unit/integration/E2E testing without mock-passing, structured JSON logs, and pre-ship gates.

name: New Full-Stack Feature Workflow
description: 4-stage sequence from DB/API contract and surface brief through accessible UI states and live multi-viewport verification.

name: Redesign & Anti-Slop Audit Workflow
description: Baseline capture, severity-ordered UI audit, cheaper-fix remediation pass, and live responsive re-verification.

name: Production Ship Gate Workflow
description: Final typecheck, production build, auth/security headers verification, and responsive/keyboard browser checks before deploy.

name: UI Skills MCP
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing list_skills and get_skill across the 800+ skill UI Skills registry.

name: Firebase Tools MCP
description: Official Firebase CLI MCP server for managing Firebase projects, Hosting, Auth, Firestore, and Data Connect from coding agents.

name: Schematik MCP
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for hardware part search and build guides (search_parts, get_part, search_build_guides, get_build_guide).

name: REA Reverse Engineering MCP
description: Local stdio MCP server for native, managed, Android, Electron, and browser bundle inspection and verification.
